United States: S&P Global Mobility vehicles in operation, light vehicles, 289M in 2025 (+3M vs 2024), May 2025 release; scrappage rate 4.5%

Finland: Statistics Finland table 11ie 'Cars by driving power' (= Traficom 'Passenger cars in traffic on 31 December'), passenger cars IN TRAFFIC, total and electricity, 2005-2025 (full history by fuel 1990-2025 and quarterly 2008Q1-2026Q3 in scripts/data/finland_fleet_by_fuel.json). Eurostat road_eqs_carage counts ALL registered cars for Finland (3.79M in 2025, incl. ~1.1M temporarily deregistered cars not in traffic); in-traffic is 2.70M
